meta.description: La Diamanteria's direct buying service: five generations of diamantaires, accredited gemmologists, Via Vincenzo Monti 47, Milan, since 2009.

slots.chisiamo-contenuto-010: Valutazione Diamanti helps private sellers have their diamonds and jewellery valued and sold. The service is run by La Diamanteria, established in Milan in 2009. The Silvera family spans five generations of
slots.chisiamo-contenuto-012: . The family's roots in the diamond trade go back more than 300 years, as documented in historical studies and articles.

slots.chisiamo-contenuto-020: Today, the Silvera brothers buy diamonds directly from private sellers. A gemmologist reviews each enquiry and the stone's characteristics. We do not send items to auction or seek buyers on your behalf.
slots.chisiamo-contenuto-022: Francesca Trivellato's book Il commercio interculturale, a study published in Quaderni storici and a newspaper article recount episodes from the family's trading history.
slots.chisiamo-contenuto-024: The Silvera family has traded diamonds for five generations; our Milan office at Via Vincenzo Monti 47 has been open since 2009. Here we welcome clients by appointment, examine your item in person and make you an offer directly. If you accept, we pay by bank transfer.
slots.chisiamo-licenza-01: Holders of a Public Security licence, authorised by the Questura (Police Headquarters).
slots.chisiamo-contenuto-026: We value more than €200 million worth of diamonds each year. Since 2015, our gemmologists, accredited by the Chamber of Commerce, have also prepared sworn valuations for estates, asset division, legal proceedings and insurance purposes.
